personality_one_liner: An elegant, Pinterest-worthy African premium marketplace combining native iOS cleanliness with glassmorphic depth and warm, aspirational lifestyle photography.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and sections must never feel cramped.

do's: Use on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind
Use on featured/hero cards sitting on a photo backdrop
Use on floating action buttons over tinted background
Ensure text on glass is fully readable by using a tinted base (>=70% opacity) underneath the blur
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields
Do not apply to every list row or dense data cards

Sticky primary CTA (Sign Up) at the absolute bottom with safe area clearance. instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION OF THEME: Base app around iOS-Native Clean with Glass/Luxe accents. The overarching feel must be 'Pinterest-worthy', 'African Premium', and highly aspirational. Use the `surface` token (#FDFBF7) as the main background for a warm, editorial feel.

COLOR USAGE: Use the existing brand Midnight (#0B1F3A) and Turquoise (#00C2A8) as primary accents. Do not use generic default blue/purple colors. Deep black/dark grey (#1A1A1A) should be used for text to maintain high contrast and readability against the off-white/beige backgrounds.

IMAGE HANDLING: ALWAYS apply a gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom, transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) over any full-bleed imagery (e.g. Onboarding, Category hero cards) where text overlay is required. This is zero-tolerance for readability.

ONBOARDING SCROLL & ANIMATION: The 5 onboarding screens must use `react-native-reanimated` for scroll parallax on the background images, fading text/headings as the user scrolls, and a sticky sign-up CTA at the bottom.

COMPONENT STYLE: Cards should have generous `lg` (24px) border radii. Avoid hard borders; rely on subtle shadow (tier 1) and generous spacing for separation. When showing categories, integrate signature icons layered over the premium photography.

PROMPTS FOR GEMINI NANO BANANA (Fallback): If generating images, use prompts like: 'Wide-angle, cinematic photograph of a modern African woman entrepreneur in a premium glass office, golden hour lighting, deep navy and warm amber tones, mobile portrait crop.'
HAPTICS: Ensure subtle haptic feedback on tab changes, button presses (like 'Book Now'), and primary actions to reinforce the premium tactile feel.
